files.V27_INITIAL_FAILURE.md:
# Initial V27 suite fixture failure

The full suite trapped during its first production module instantiation, following the new synthetic dispatcher matrix. Stack function 434 was instantiate_staged_modules and function 177 the logging formatting path (27 imported functions precede defined functions in Binaryen output). The standalone suite had not initialized log::filterings; unlike the existing hot-rom tests, this fixture logs a named module. cpu_fault_probe already initializes filtering to off, and its same-production module-dispatch probes passed.

The test fixture now initializes the logging filter identically to the native fault probe. Its new real-runner CPU state also explicitly resets/assigns mem_cache_, matching existing runner fixtures. No production source changed in this retry. Rebuild only the test executable, preserve the original failed log/archive, require a fresh full-suite pass and verify production/probe artifact identity before reusing acceptance.
